# MiRust

MiRust.com is the public root-discovery and talisman surface for the Rust-oriented project family. It is not the implementation host, not a model host, and not a remote inference service.

## Verified Public Root Files

- https://mirust.com/
- https://mirust.com/llms.txt
- https://mirust.com/llms-full.txt
- https://mirust.com/robots.txt
- https://mirust.com/mirust-public-sitemap.xml
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/uaix-talisman.txt
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/ai-ready-route-inventory.json
- https://mirust.com/.well-known/mirust-site.json

The root-discovery package does not currently assert topical WordPress-style page routes unless they are separately verified live. Agents should not infer that a named research topic has a public MiRust route unless the route returns 200 and is listed in current root-discovery files.

## Project Constellation

MiRust.com is the coordinator and public evidence talisman. In this project, talisman means a durable, human-visible identity and boundary record: it preserves the map of names, subdomains, evidence ownership, support boundaries, and no-op behavior. It does not certify readiness, grant authentication, or run a model.

Current implementation-facing lanes:

- https://tinyrustlm.mirust.com/ - TinyRustLM.MiRust.com is the TinyRustLM developer portal. It contains the absorbed legacy runtime docs, reports, package metadata, page registry, and checksum manifest under `/docs/runtime-portal/`.
- https://tinyrustlm.com/ - TinyRustLM.com is the root-domain browser-local Rust/WASM app. Users import local `.slm` files through the browser file picker.
- https://minimodel.mirust.com/ - MiniModel.MiRust.com is the developer documentation surface for MiniModel model exchange planning.
- https://gguf.mirust.com/ - GGUF.MiRust.com remains the GGUF-facing implementation identity and future native GGUF parser evidence lane.

Retired or redirecting identities:

- SLMComposer.com is no longer the canonical public app identity. Current app access lives at https://tinyrustlm.com/.
- LMComposer.com is no longer a separate public product route. Current app access lives at https://tinyrustlm.com/.

## Packaging Boundary

Public deployables are root-discovery files, `.well-known` manifests, checksums, and validation reports. Private UAI memory and private website-source bundles are maintainer handoff artifacts and are not public web-root deployables.

MiRust.com coordinates and cites implementation lanes. Public MiRust root-discovery packages do not distribute GGUF/TinyRustLM implementation source, Rust implementation source, WebAssembly binaries, `.slm` files, adapter sidecars, GGUF artifacts, model weights, model execution, model training, model merging, or runtime authority.

## Agent Behavior

Read visible root files, cite canonical routes, follow robots and terms, do not infer hidden authority, and no-op unsupported requests. For TinyRustLM implementation evidence, use TinyRustLM.MiRust.com. For the browser-local app, use TinyRustLM.com. For MiniModel exchange documentation, use MiniModel.MiRust.com.
